content:
Oliver (Product): Hey team — planning to take 10 weeks parental leave starting Mon Feb 6 and want a phased return (4 weeks at 60% then full time). What approvals and benefit/pto proration should I expect? Also need short-term hiring coverage for a product contractor.

People Ops Bot: Start the leave at https://hr.redwood.com/leave and set Return Plan -> 'Phased (custom)'. Manager sign-off required for reduced hours. Benefits FAQ: https://benefits.redwood.com/phased-return.

Jess (Mgr): I can approve the phased schedule. Please draft a 1-paragraph plan with core hours and async expectations.

Benefits: Health benefits continue during paid parental leave. If you drop to part-time during phased return, medical premiums may be prorated depending on hours; we'll confirm after the leave form. Short-term reduced hours may affect 401(k) matching in the month(s) of reduced pay.

Hiring Ops: For the contractor, submit a Coverage Request to hiring-ops@redwood.com with end date and tasks. We can fast-track extensions or a temp hire.

Oliver (Product): Great — uploading leave + phased plan now. Quick checklist I'm pasting: 
```
- Submit leave form and attach phased-return plan
- Manager sign-off for reduced hours (Jess)
- Benefits to confirm premium/match proration (benefits@redwood.com)
- File Hiring Ops coverage request for contractor (hiring-ops@redwood.com)
- Set emergency contact and handoff doc link
```

Jess (Mgr): I'll review and approve once you upload. Hiring Ops, please hold a short approval window for the contractor so we don't interrupt Q1 work.

Hiring Ops: Noted — will prioritize after ticket lands.

Oliver (Product): Thanks all :pray: will post the handoff link when done.
